caveat: New immutable Week7 cohort; unvalidated experiment, not a betting edge. Baseline frozen and shown beside it.
method: Same Oct7 fitted practice/status residual-margin coefficients as Week 5/6 cohorts, no refit (fit sha256 87e03553c5bd90a1123710d222e25af72042262f3251c6c24bfb30563545e358). Snap weights through Week6; 2025 fallback for missing. IR inventory + verified news only; adjustment relative to no-injury row. No book/weather inputs or manual point bumps.
limitations: Week 7 practice participation and game-status designations are not issued until Wednesday Oct 21; this cohort reflects the provider IR inventory (week 6 roster rows) plus verified news statuses (Hurts, Adams, Ford) only, so report-based absences (Out/Doubtful/Questionable/DNP) are NOT yet reflected. Expect material changes when reports land.
IR provider inventory is not a 32-team transaction audit and long absences can already be in the scores-only baseline, so double counting is possible.
Missing snap roles have zero contribution and are listed, not assumed healthy.
No fitted DNP play probability or teammate redistribution.
Totals and home-win probabilities stay baseline; the injury-total candidate worsened diagnostics.
Unproven: two straight one-week diagnostics (Weeks 5 and 6) favored the baseline. Shown beside the baseline per the standing Oct 7 instruction; NOT promoted.
